name: Spinach-Artichoke Yogurt Dip with Toasted Naan

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the naan.)
Wash and dry the spinach (skip if it came pre-washed). Roughly chop and place in a medium bowl; set aside.
Peel and mince garlic. Peel, halve, and mince onion.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
½ medium red onion

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and mince artichokes.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (170 ml) jars artichoke hearts, marinated

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic, onion, and salt; cook, stirring often, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Add spinach to the skillet in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Continue to cook, while stirring, until spinach is completely wilted, 2-3 minutes more. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
When the spinach is done, remove from heat. Stir in the artichokes and set aside to cool slightly, 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, place yogurt, salt, and crushed red pepper in the reserved bowl. Whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups plain Greek yogurt
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the cooled spinach-artichoke mixture to the bowl with the yogurt. Stir to combine the dip and set aside.

Arrange naan on a large baking sheet pan. Place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.) Cut into wedges.
To serve, divide toasted naan and dip between plates. Enjoy!
